To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the combination of document structure with layout-driven interdependencies is beneficial for content extraction and (2) the proposed loopy random field is an appropriate model to capture these interdependencies.
the combination of document structure, page layout and a realistic set of features leads to a significant improvement over state-of-the-art methods in the field of web content extraction.

the combination of document structure with page layout leads to a significant improvement of the results in web content extraction, that the proposed loopy conditional random fields provide a powerful framework for the combination of different interdependencies and that the tree-based re-parameterization framework is a suitable approach to learn loopy conditional random models.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following contributions: (i) we propose a new model for web content extraction that combines the advantages of document structure and page layouts, (ii) we propose a realistic set of features that capture the semantics of a web page region and the interdependencies between the regions, and (iii) we propose a novel approach to learn loopy conditional random fields in a tree-based reparameterized form.
the development of an efficient and accurate method to automatically extract semantically interesting regions from web pages.
the design of novel loopy random fields that can effectively exploit both document structure and web page layout for web news content analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed model is the first to combine both document structure and layout information in the framework of a loopy conditional model, that it is the first to exploit the rich set of features derived from document structure and page layouts, and that it is the only model which can be efficiently learnt in a tree-based reparameterized framework.
our approach outperforms the current state of the art in web content extraction.
our proposed loopy random fields model is the best performing model on this task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
document structure and page-layout features are complementary and can be combined to improve the performance of web content extraction.
we have proposed and implemented a loopy conditional field for web news content region extraction.

we have developed a novel approach for the automatic identification of web page regions that is capable of exploiting the rich interdependencies between regions, their latent semantics and the local characteristics of the page regions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
document structure and page layouts are complementary in the task of web content extraction and can be effectively combined to achieve better performance.
the combination of document structure with page layout is a very promising approach for the extraction of web page regions with a high semantic relevance.
the structure of the DOM tree, which is a crucial part of the document, should be taken into account in the process of content extraction.
